# Discovery and effort test fixtures

The 1.1.28 and 1.2.2 directories contain synthetic documentation-derived test inputs. They are not captured native output and do not establish binary compatibility. They cover required flags, additive metadata, opaque model IDs, malformed output and empty inventory.

The 1.5.17 effort fixture contains normalized regression scenarios for adjustable, fixed and limited effort, exact model reporting, conflicting flags and a nonzero-exit result. No account, project, session or host identity is included. These are test vectors, not a live qualification report.

See the [headless CLI documentation](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/) and [effort documentation](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/effort/).
